annotations.target_phrase: What parallel courses did Bloom and Stephen follow returning?
annotations.annotation_text: The famous opening question of Episode 17 (Ithaca). 2:00 AM. 7 Eccles Street. Joyce's favorite episode, composed entirely in impersonal, scientific catechism (questions and answers). Reduces the heroic homecoming of Odysseus and Telemachus to mathematical equations, astronomical coordinates, and physical laws.
sources: Gilbert, Stuart. James Joyce's Ulysses: A Study. Faber, 1930.
Gifford, Don, and Robert J. Seidman. Ulysses Annotated. UC Press, 1988, p. 566.

annotations.target_phrase: the key of the front door was in the pocket of the other trousers
annotations.annotation_text: The comedic climax of the homecoming: Bloom has forgotten the latchkey of 7 Eccles Street in his morning trousers, mirroring Stephen's earlier dispossession of the Martello Tower key by Buck Mulligan in Episode 1.
sources: Ellmann, Richard. James Joyce. Oxford UP, 1982.
Kenner, Hugh. Ulysses. Johns Hopkins UP, 1987.
